text: Iran stated military operations had ceased while warning of renewed strikes under specified conditions. Israel reported strikes inside Iran. U.S. statements referenced ongoing negotiations and maintenance of a regional blockade. Public claims regarding ceasefire status remained non-unified across participating actors. Oil prices retraced after an initial spike.

meta.note: Ceasefire status and operational status are reported concurrently without unified verification.

text: Apple announced a rebuilt Siri, new foundation models, expanded AI integrations, agent-style password management, and additional platform-level AI features. Tim Cook publicly marked his final WWDC appearance before a scheduled CEO handoff to John Ternus. Multiple new capabilities were integrated through a common platform architecture and device ecosystem.

meta.note: Product releases and leadership transfer were disclosed within the same event but remain structurally distinct.
